notes: NPC-0 §4 command 8 NPC_TRADE_INTENT and §5.5 (NPC_SINGLE_TRADE_COMMIT_V1); NPC trade shape only, the one-item DUR03-RL-01..08 and fee DUR03-RL-*-FEE-BURN rows are unchanged; registered by OTV2-20261013-npc-trade-1.
